about: Capabilities this engine serves before the release that publishes their schemas declares them. A capability added between releases pins its schemas at the tag of the release that will ship it (AGENTS.md, Releasing; ENG-018), and fabric-agent.json may not pin a tag newer than the engine's version (tools/check_manifest_urls.py), so the declaration waits here and interop.mcp_capabilities serves it from here. The release whose version reaches the pinned tag moves each entry into fabric-agent.json's capabilities (provider.revision + 1, tools/fabric_hash.py), empties this list and updates the probe and revision counts; tests/test_ops_digest_record.py fails until it does.

capabilities.name: ops.digest.record

probes.description: A bounded probe against an explicitly selected synthetic fixture workspace, its stdio server started without an access binding.
assertions: a stdio server started without an access binding refuses the line with binding-required
no line is kept: the digest store is unchanged after the call

capabilities.description: A product's daily operations digest (fabric-agent-contract DEC-0153, release tag v0.1.0+2026-11-06.1): one ops.digest.daily@1 line as a JSON object, its source label (default app) and optionally the Fabric service {id, instance} it came from, checked against the contract's closed schema, FAC-SEM-166, FAC-SEM-167 and the source clause of FAC-SEM-168. The project is never an argument: over stdio it is the one project of the access binding the server runs under (--binding-token-file, a binding with the scope ops.digest.record and the effect propose), without one the answer is binding-required; on the memory-http door it is the project claim of a delegation token the hub minted for project-observatory with the scope ops.digest.record, without one delegation-required. One record per project, service, source and UTC day: the same body again changes nothing (repeated true), a different one is the next revision, and a reader reads the first. Counts only, kept 400 days.
